description: This file is a C++ test implementation for a WorkerPool system, including classes for managing test jobs, tasks, and a test administrator that runs automated tests on the worker pool, including job scheduling, revoking, and reporting.

classes.name: WorkerPoolTestAdministrator
classes.description: A class that manages a worker pool, submits jobs, and performs automated testing including job scheduling, revoking, and reporting.

classes.name: WorkerPoolImplementation
classes.description: A nested class implementing a worker pool with a dispatcher for executing jobs.

classes.name: TesterTask
classes.description: Represents a test job with metadata, capable of dispatching and updating its status.

classes.name: MonitorTask
classes.description: A task that triggers analysis of test jobs periodically.

methods.name: ResetAndActivateWorkerPool
methods.description: Resets and starts the worker pool with random thread and queue sizes.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the test administrator by resetting and activating the worker pool.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Starts the worker pool if valid.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Stops the worker pool if valid.

methods.name: Notify
methods.description: Signals the event indicating test completion.

methods.name: WaitForTestCompletion
methods.description: Waits for test completion event with a timeout.

methods.name: getRandomValue
methods.description: Generates a random value within a specified range.

methods.name: getNextJobId
methods.description: Generates the next unique job ID.

methods.name: SubmitTestJob
methods.description: Submits a new test job to the worker pool.

methods.name: UpdateJobDetails
methods.description: Updates the status of a job, rescheduling or removing it based on its metadata.

methods.name: RevokeRandomJobs
methods.description: Randomly revokes a subset of active jobs.

methods.name: RescheduleRandomJobs
methods.description: Randomly reschedules active jobs for future execution.

methods.name: GenerateAndTestAutomatedJobs
methods.description: Generates a large number of test jobs and submits them for execution.

methods.name: GenerateTestReport
methods.description: Outputs a report on completed or failed jobs.

methods.name: AnalyseTestTask
methods.description: Analyzes current jobs and triggers rescheduling, revoking, or completion signals.

methods.name: StartMonitorJob
methods.description: Starts the monitoring task that periodically analyzes jobs.
